theater: 頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克州

battle.name: 頓巴斯戰爭
battle.theater: 頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克州
battle.brief: 二〇一四年三月，烏克蘭部隊與頓巴斯親俄武裝在斯洛維揚斯克、克拉馬托斯克一線交火，四月兩地宣告獨立，全面內戰爆發。卡面這輛一九七三年蘇聯T-72主戰坦克，既是烏軍裝甲縱隊的骨幹，也大量落入分離主義武裝手中，成為接觸線上最常見的戰車。

kit.name: T-72主戰坦克
kit.history: T-72是蘇聯陸軍的主戰坦克，位於裝甲部隊的作戰核心，負責正面突破、反裝甲與佔領重要地形，並協同步兵作戰。

countries: 交戰的兩方，一方是烏克蘭國家一方，一方是自稱「頓涅茨克人民共和國」與「盧甘斯克人民共和國」的武裝。烏方最高決策層由總統、總理、國防部與總參謀部構成：代理總統奧列克桑德·圖爾丘諾夫在二〇一四年二月至六月主持國安會議，調度部隊進入頓巴斯；六月七日彼得羅·波羅申科接任總統，總理阿爾先尼·亞岑紐克留任，國防部先後由代部長亨納季·普洛特尼茨基、米哈伊洛·科齊賓斯基主持，北方作戰司令部負責東線的作戰計畫。地面部隊由陸軍第93、第95機械化旅，第24機械化旅，第128山地旅，以及第4獨立坦克旅、第11與第12獨立坦克旅、第4獨立摩步旅所屬的坦克營與步兵營組成；內政部「金雕」「力量」特種部隊與國安局「阿爾法」分隊在開局階段負責奪回城鎮。民兵方面，「阿佐夫」營、第57機械化旅第3營、「第聶伯羅-1」「頓巴斯」「艾達爾」「米羅托沃列茨」等志願營吸收烏軍逃兵、礦工武裝與地方居民。DPR、LPR 兩地的武裝有伊戈爾·斯特列爾科夫領導的「頓巴斯人民民兵」，九月成立的「奧普洛特」，由第12坦克旅叛離者組成的坦克營「蛇」，瓦西里·博洛托夫掌控的盧甘斯克民兵，以及招募俄羅斯現役與預備役人員的志願營。俄羅斯否認派兵作戰，但歐安組織觀察團多次記錄俄造T-72B3、BM-21火箭炮與反裝甲武器越境；俄方以軍事顧問、教官、資金與物資提供實質支援，卻在二〇一四年未正式承認兩個「共和國」的主權地位。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were, on the one hand, the Ukrainian state and its armed forces, and on the other, the armed formations of the self-proclaimed Donetsk People's Republic and Luhansk People's Republic. The Ukrainian side was directed at the top by the president, the prime minister, the Ministry of Defence and the General Staff. The acting president Oleksandr Turchynov chaired the National Security and Defence Council from February to June 2014 and dispatched troops into the Donbas; on 7 June Petro Poroshenko was sworn in as president, with the prime minister Arseniy Yatsenyuk remaining in office, while the Ministry of Defence was run in turn by acting ministers Hennadiy Plotnytskyi and Mykhailo Kotsiubynskyi, and the Operational Command North planned the eastern front. The ground forces were drawn from the 93rd, 95th, 24th and 128th brigades of the army, together with the tank and infantry companies of the 4th Separate Tank Brigade, the 11th and 12th Separate Tank Brigades and the 4th Separate Motor Rifle Brigade; the Interior Ministry's Berkut and Vityaz special forces and the SBU Alpha detachment were responsible for retaking towns in the opening phase. On the militia side, the Azov battalion, the 3rd Battalion of the 57th Mechanised Brigade, and volunteer formations such as Dnipro-1, Donbas, Aidar and Myrotvorets absorbed deserters from the Ukrainian army, miners' self-defence groups and local residents. The forces of the two republics included Igor Strelkov's People's Militia of Donbas, Oplot, founded in September, the Som tank battalion formed from deserters of the 12th Tank Brigade, the Luhansk militia under Valery Bolotov, and volunteer units recruiting serving and reserve personnel of the Russian army. Russia denied that its troops were fighting, but OSCE monitors repeatedly recorded Russian-made T-72B3 tanks, BM-21 rocket launchers and anti-tank weapons crossing the border; Moscow provided military advisers, instructors, money and materiel, and yet in 2014 it did not formally recognise the sovereignty of the two self-declared republics.
people: 關鍵人物方面，烏克蘭一端以圖爾丘諾夫主持的國安會議最為關鍵，波羅申科則在同年九月五日簽署《明斯克議定書》、十一月十二日簽署《明斯克協議》，成為烏克蘭處置頓巴斯的對外窗口；國防部長的更替（普洛特尼茨基、科齊賓斯基）反映當時內部對作戰主導權的爭論，總參謀部與作戰司令部之間的指揮摩擦在春末至夏初多次顯現。前線上，第93機械化旅、第128山地旅與第4獨立坦克旅的指揮官主導了馬林卡、頓涅茨克機場與德巴爾切韋三次方向性攻勢；「阿佐夫」營裝甲連連長朱拉夫廖夫中尉據報率一輛T-64BV參與馬里烏波爾守備。分離主義一端，伊戈爾·斯特列爾科夫以「頓巴斯人民民兵」指揮官的身分在三月二日攻入斯洛維揚斯克、奪下當地國安局大樓，四月轉赴盧甘斯克主持民兵；出身烏軍第8獨立摩步師的亞歷山大·扎哈爾琴科指揮「東方」營，二〇一四年八月出任DPR總理，次年被暗殺；盧甘斯克方面的瓦西里·博洛托夫掌控武裝，其後在一次汽車炸彈攻擊中身亡。俄羅斯方面，總統普京在克里米亞被吞併後拍板採取「特別措施」，並派軍事顧問與教官赴頓巴斯；外交上由駐烏大使維克托爾·舒布與歐安組織觀察團的核查報告構成外部視角，美國駐烏大使傑弗里·派特則代表西方觀察方。志願者與外國顧問網絡亦構成一股獨立的非國家力量。
peopleEn: On the Ukrainian side the decisive figures were the National Security and Defence Council chaired by Turchynov, while Poroshenko, as the man who signed the Minsk Protocol on 5 September and the Minsk agreements on 12 November, became the country's public face on the Donbas. The turnover in the defence ministry, with Plotnytskyi and then Kotsiubynskyi acting, reflected the internal argument over who should direct operations, and friction between the General Staff and the operational command showed itself repeatedly in the late spring and early summer. On the front line, the commanders of the 93rd Mechanised Brigade, the 128th Mountain Brigade and the 4th Separate Tank Brigade directed the three set-piece offensives at Marinka, Donetsk Airport and Debaltseve; the company commander of the Azov regiment's armour company, Lieutenant Zhuravlyov, is reported to have led a T-64BV in the defence of Mariupol. On the separatist side Igor Strelkov, commanding the People's Militia of Donbas, entered Sloviansk on 2 March 2014 and seized the local security service headquarters, before moving to Luhansk in April to run the militia there. Alexander Zakharchenko, an officer of Ukraine's 8th Separate Motor Rifle Brigade, commanded the Vostok battalion and became prime minister of the DPR in August 2014; he was assassinated the following year. In Luhansk the armed formations were controlled by Valery Bolotov, who was later killed in a car bomb attack. On the Russian side President Putin decided on the special measures after the annexation of Crimea and dispatched military advisers and instructors to the Donbas; diplomatically the external view was carried by the ambassador to Ukraine, Viktor Shub, and by the verification reports of the OSCE mission, with the United States represented by its ambassador to Ukraine, Geoffrey Pyatt. Networks of volunteers and foreign advisers also formed an independent, non-state force.
kits: 裝備方面，卡面這輛T-72是蘇聯一九七三年定型的第三代主戰坦克：一百二十五毫米滑膛炮、十二發自動裝填機炮彈藥加四十發彈架備彈、一挺十二點七毫米同軸高射機槍、V-46-6型柴油發動機、公路時速約六十公里，作戰全重約四十一噸。烏克蘭陸軍在頓巴斯的主力坦克是T-72B與T-72B3型，配「接觸-1」反裝甲炸藥與「松樹-U」熱成像瞄具，隸屬第4、第11、第12獨立坦克旅及第93機械化旅的坦克營，第93旅另配T-64BV。二〇一一年至二〇一二年俄羅斯曾向烏克蘭交付數十輛T-72B3作為債務清償，這批車在二〇一四年成為分離主義武裝手中T-72的主要來源。五月初，烏軍在馬里烏波爾海軍基地丟失一輛貼著「自由」標語的T-72B，該車隨後被三名分離主義武裝人員接管並在前線作戰，同月二十四日被烏軍尋回；由第12坦克旅叛離者組成的「蛇」營則直接以成建制的T-72B投入九月以後的攻勢。雙方步兵與砲兵的裝備同樣密集：2A36「春花」自行加榴炮、2S19「雷石」自行加榴炮、2S25、2S3「金剛石」、9A52「龍捲風」與BM-21「冰雹」火箭炮、122毫米D-30與152毫米榴彈炮，TOS-1A火焰火箭、BMD、BTR-80、BMP-1與BMP-2、ZIL-131運輸車構成縱隊骨幹；空軍投入Mi-8、Mi-24、Su-25與Su-24M，地面反裝甲則以RPG-7、RPG-16、「戰斧」與「金屬矛」導彈、肩扛式防空導彈「箭-2」為主。九月盧甘斯克上空擊落伊爾-76的「山毛櫸」防空系統，是二〇一四年烏軍最重型的裝備投入之一。
kitsEn: On the equipment side, the T-72 on the card is the third-generation main battle tank type the Soviet Union finalised in 1973: a 125 mm smoothbore gun, twenty-two rounds in the autoloader with forty more in the ready rack, a 12.7 mm coaxial machine gun, the V-46-6 diesel engine, a road speed of about 60 km/h and a combat weight of roughly 41 tonnes. The Ukrainian army's main tanks in the Donbas were the T-72B and T-72B3, fitted with Kontakt-1 explosive reactive armour and Sosna-U thermal sights, belonging to the 4th, 11th and 12th Separate Tank Brigades and to the tank company of the 93rd Mechanised Brigade, which also had T-64BVs. Between 2011 and 2012 Russia delivered several dozen T-72B3s to Ukraine as a debt settlement, and these vehicles became the principal source of the T-72s in separatist hands in 2014. In early May a Ukrainian T-72B carrying the slogan Freedom was lost at the Mariupol marine base; it was taken over by a crew of three separatist fighters and used on the front line before Ukrainian forces recovered it on the twenty-fourth of the same month. The Som battalion, made up of deserters from the 12th Tank Brigade, committed intact T-72B companies to the offensives launched from September onwards. The infantry and artillery of both sides were equally densely equipped: 2A36 Giatsint and 2S19 Msta self-propelled howitzers, 2S25, 2S3 Akatsiya, 9A52 Smerch and BM-21 Grad rocket launchers, 122 mm D-30 and 152 mm howitzers, TOS-1A flamethrower rockets, BMD, BTR-80, BMP-1 and BMP-2 and ZIL-131 trucks formed the backbone of the columns; the air arm committed Mi-8 and Mi-24 helicopters and Su-25 and Su-24M aircraft, while the ground anti-tank effort rested on RPG-7 and RPG-16 launchers, Fagorot and Met-M guided missiles and Strela-2 man-portable air defence launchers. The Buk air defence system, which shot down an Il-76 over Luhansk in September, was one of the heaviest Ukrainian equipment commitments of 2014.
tactics: 戰術層面，二〇一四年三四月的頓巴斯沒有前線，只有城鎮與公路：內政部特種部隊與國安局分隊沿M-04（基輔—頓涅茨克）與M-03（哈爾科夫—頓涅茨克）兩條幹線晝夜推進，以車組縱隊、臨時檢查站與快速奪樓的樣式作戰，先後奪回斯洛維揚斯克、克拉馬托斯克、安多莫夫斯克等城；對方則以武裝皮卡車、牽引式反坦克導彈發射組與重機槍在路旁埋伏，專打縱隊中的指揮車與後勤車，四月十一日佔領頓涅茨克州警察總部大樓即屬此類突襲。五月至七月轉入「巡邏戰」：雙方小分隊在城鎮外圍與郊野之間反覆穿插，沒有明確接觸線，多以夜襲、伏擊與地雷作戰，烏軍步兵因自攜反坦克武器有限而以加強步兵班同行，砲兵支援也因彈藥與射界受限而難以連續支援。四月起烏軍才開始以T-72B在步兵掩護下實施縱深突擊，馬林卡六月之役即是典型：坦克停在射擊陣位，以一二五毫米炮直瞄射擊塹壕內的目標，步兵分隊隨後上陣；此後德巴爾切韋方向的攻勢同樣以裝甲為矛，卻因十二月底的嚴寒、泥濘與燃油結膠而拉長。分離主義武裝的戰術核心是反坦克伏擊：把T-64BV與T-72B停在土工掩體後方只開火不露面，待烏軍縱隊逼近才以RPG-7與火箭炮齊射；「蛇」營與BM-21、2S19炮兵在九月後的攻勢中配合封鎖公路，切斷烏軍自西方運來的補給線。烏軍則以縱深梯次、射擊陣位與「先砲兵、後步兵」的次序應對，並靠九月五日的《明斯克議定書》換來數週停火；停火在十月中旬破裂之後，德巴爾切韋與伊洛瓦伊斯克兩役的裝甲與砲兵運用，才真正固定了二〇一四年底接觸線的走向。
tacticsEn: At the tactical level, the Donbas of March and April 2014 had no front line, only towns and roads. Interior Ministry special forces and SBU detachments pushed day and night along the M-04 highway between Kyiv and Donetsk and the M-03 between Kharkiv and Donetsk, fighting as vehicle columns, temporary checkpoints and rapid building seizures, and retaking in turn Sloviansk, Kramatorsk, Antomovsk and other towns. The other side ambushed from the roadside with technicals, towed anti-tank guided missile crews and heavy machine guns, concentrating on command vehicles and logistics trucks in the columns; the seizure of the Donetsk regional police headquarters on 11 April was a raid of exactly this kind. From May to July the conflict turned into a war of patrols: small detachments infiltrated in and out around the towns and the open country, with no coherent line of contact, and night raids, ambushes and mines carried the day. Ukrainian infantry, short of organic anti-tank weapons, moved in reinforced squads, and artillery support was hard to sustain because of ammunition limits and restricted fields of fire. Only from April did the Ukrainian army begin deep attacks with T-72B tanks under infantry cover, and the battle of Marinka in June was the type example: the tanks held firing positions and fired their 125 mm guns directly into targets in the trench line, with infantry squads following. The later offensive toward Debaltseve was similarly armour-led, but was stretched out by the severe cold of late December, by mud and by fuel gelling. The core separatist tactic was the anti-tank ambush: T-64BVs and T-72Bs were held in earthworks, firing without exposing themselves, and only opened up with RPG-7s and rocket artillery when Ukrainian columns closed; from September the Som battalion and BM-21 and 2S19 batteries worked with the infantry to seal the roads and cut the supply line bringing materiel in from the west. The Ukrainian answer was echeloned depth, firing positions and the sequence of artillery first and infantry second, and they bought several weeks of stillness with the Minsk Protocol of 5 September; only after that ceasefire broke down in mid-October did the use of armour and artillery at Debaltseve and Ilovaisk fix the shape of the line of contact at the end of 2014.
data: 數字方面，歐安組織觀察團在二〇一四年八月的公開評估稱，烏方投入頓巴斯的部隊已由三月的四千上下增至八千六百人上下；分離主義武裝的兵力在同年九月約為數千人，至年底的各種評估則落在萬人上下至兩萬以上，口徑不一。同一時期的觀察團報告曾把自三月十四日以來烏方軍人的傷亡總數估到數千人量級，分離主義武裝的傷亡估到至少上千人，雙方均無一致的官方統計。裝備損失方面，烏克蘭在二〇一四年失去的坦克與裝甲車輛以數百輛計，其中相當一部分死於反坦克火箭彈、地雷與炮火直接命中，各方數字相差甚大；觀察團先後記錄多批T-72B3、BM-21火箭炮與反裝甲武器越境進入烏克蘭，烏方則在八月向觀察團提交被指越境的裝備清單。戰役強度上，頓涅茨克機場第二次戰役（十月下旬起）與德巴爾切韋戰役（十二月十九日至次年一月十六日）被視為二〇一四年最慘烈的兩役，烏方公布陣亡人數皆以數百人量級計；九月五日停火生效後，觀察團在數週之內即記錄數百起違例，至年底累積逾千起。接觸線在年底已延伸數百公里，雙方火力接觸帶的縱深仍只數公里，而烏軍自西方運來的補給線要延伸數百公里。
dataEn: On the numbers, the OSCE mission's public assessment in August 2014 put Ukrainian troops committed to the Donbas at around 8,600, up from some 4,000 in March. The strength of the separatist formations was assessed at a few thousand in September 2014, while the various estimates published towards the end of the year ranged from around ten thousand to more than twenty thousand, the counting methods differing. Reports from the same mission assessed the total casualties among Ukrainian military personnel since 14 March at a figure in the thousands, and those among the separatists at at least a thousand; neither side published consistent official statistics. As for equipment losses, Ukraine lost tanks and armoured vehicles in the hundreds during 2014, a large share of them killed by anti-tank rockets, mines and direct artillery hits, and the various figures differ widely. The mission recorded on several occasions convoys of T-72B3 tanks, BM-21 rocket launchers and anti-tank weapons crossing into Ukraine, and in August the Ukrainian side handed the monitors a list of equipment alleged to have entered the border illegally. As for the intensity of the fighting, the second battle of Donetsk Airport, from late October, and the battle of Debaltseve, from 19 December 2014 to 16 January 2015, are regarded as the two most costly engagements of 2014, with Ukrainian published death tolls in the hundreds in each case; after the ceasefire of 5 September the monitors recorded several hundred violations within weeks, accumulating to more than a thousand by the end of the year. The line of contact stretched for several hundred kilometres by the end of the year, while the depth of direct fire engagement on both sides remained only a few kilometres, although the Ukrainian supply line running in from the west had to extend for hundreds of kilometres.
cause: 起因方面，這場戰爭的遠因是二〇一四年二月的「歐洲廣場」運動推翻亞努科維奇政府，以及俄羅斯隨即吞併克里米亞。三月一日俄軍進入克里米亞，三月二日武裝人員佔領辛菲羅波爾議會大樓，局勢在頓巴斯迅速升級：三月二日，武裝人員在盧甘斯克與頓涅茨克奪取州府大樓與警察機關；二月以來累積的親俄民兵轉為公開武裝；三月十四日基輔宣布在頓涅茨克州展開反恐行動，烏軍進駐，衝突隨即全面化。四月七日與二十七日，頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克分別宣布成立「人民共和國」並要求俄羅斯提供保護，俄方派兵接管邊境，烏克蘭境內若干城鎮隨之陷入包圍。俄羅斯的決策層在此階段作出採取「特別措施」的判斷，外交上則以歐安組織核查作為拖延的框架；五月以來武裝衝突擴散到全境，四月十一日的《日內瓦聲明》與九月五日的《明斯克議定書》先後嘗試把戰線固定，但停火在十月中旬破裂，雙方重啟大規模進攻，十一月的《明斯克協議》再訂撤出重武器、恢復地方選舉等條款，一月底至二月初的聯合國人權事務專員辦公室報告則把責任歸於烏方未能保障人權。戰爭自此擺脫事件性質，成為一場長期消耗。
causeEn: As for causes, the distant background is the Euromaidan movement of February 2014, which brought down the Yanukovych government, and the Russian annexation of Crimea that followed immediately. Russian troops entered Crimea on 1 March, armed men seized the parliament building in Simferopol on 2 March, and in the Donbas the situation escalated just as fast: on 2 March armed men took the regional administration buildings and the police stations in Luhansk and Donetsk, the pro-Russian militias that had been gathering since February turned openly armed, and on 14 March Kyiv announced a counter-terrorist operation in Donetsk oblast, the army moving in and the fighting becoming general. On 7 and 27 April Donetsk and Luhansk respectively declared themselves peoples' republics and asked Russia for protection; Russian troops took over the border and several Ukrainian towns were surrounded. The Russian leadership made its decision to take the special measures at this stage, and diplomatically the framework of OSCE verification was used to stall. From May the armed conflict spread across the whole region; the Geneva statement of 11 April and the Minsk Protocol of 5 September both attempted to fix a line, but the ceasefire broke down in mid-October, both sides resumed large-scale attacks, and the Minsk agreements of November added provisions on withdrawing heavy weapons and restoring local elections, while the reports of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights at the end of January and in February attributed responsibility for the continuing violence to the Ukrainian authorities' failure to protect human rights. From then on the war ceased to be an incident and became an attritional campaign.
impact: 影響方面，這場戰爭把烏克蘭的軍隊與政治體制整體改寫。軍事上，二〇一四年的實戰暴露了裝甲部隊火力運用不熟、反裝甲手段不足、指揮鏈條反應遲緩等問題，二〇一五年起烏軍展開北約標準化改革，重建第14、第17坦克旅等單位，裝甲部隊由縱隊突進轉向以射擊陣位配合反坦克導彈的打法；志願營體制與「阿佐夫」的實戰經驗也改變了徵兵與後備制度。政治上，頓巴斯由內政問題變成歐洲安全議題，歐盟與美國的制裁、歐安組織核查機制成為常態，烏克蘭的能源、鋼鐵與糧食出口方向被迫重排，歐洲安全架構也因北約東翼提高警戒而重新調整。戰爭同時製造了持久的地區分割：兩個「人民共和國」控制頓巴斯相連的一片地區，形成此後多年不變的接觸線；二〇二二年俄羅斯正是沿著這條線集結部隊，把二〇一四年定下的格局一口氣推翻。經濟上，頓巴斯的煤炭、鋼鐵與化工產能大量停擺或淪為戰線後方，烏克蘭的工業與財政結構長期受壓。軍事技術上，二〇一四年確立的坦克手不應獨自出動、反坦克手段以導彈為主這一套經驗，直接演化成烏克蘭後來的無人機與反坦克飛彈打法。
impactEn: In terms of impact, the war rewrote the Ukrainian army and political system as a whole. Militarily, the fighting of 2014 exposed the armoured troops' unfamiliarity with the use of fire, the shortage of anti-tank means and the slow reaction of the chain of command; from 2015 the army began NATO-standardisation reforms, rebuilt units such as the 14th and 17th Tank Brigades, and moved away from armoured columns dashing forward towards the practice of fighting from firing positions with the support of anti-tank guided missiles. The system of volunteer formations and the combat experience of Azov also reshaped conscription and the reserve system. Politically, the Donbas turned from an internal matter into a European security question: sanctions by the European Union and the United States and the verification machinery of the OSCE became the norm; the directions in which Ukraine exported energy, steel and grain had to be rearranged; and the European security architecture was readjusted as the NATO eastern flank raised its guard. The war also produced a durable partition of the region: the two republics controlled a contiguous stretch of the Donbas, forming the line of contact that would remain for years to come; in 2022 Russia massed its forces along exactly that line and overturned in a single stroke the settlement arranged in 2014. Economically, large parts of the coal, steel and chemical capacity of the Donbas shut down or fell behind the front line, and the industrial and fiscal structure of Ukraine was under long-term strain. At the level of military technology, the lessons of 2014, that tank commanders should not operate alone and that anti-tank work should be built around guided missiles, evolved directly into the drone and anti-tank missile doctrine Ukraine later adopted.
result: 結果方面，二〇一四年沒有分出勝負，只定下了一條線。烏軍在十月中旬停火破裂後重拾攻勢：十月下旬發動的頓涅茨克機場第二次戰役以守方慘烈傷亡告終，烏軍退守新航站樓；十二月二十六日烏軍進入德巴爾切韋，切斷了兩支分離主義縱隊的退路，烏方公布此役陣亡人數在數百人上下；十二月下旬至次年一月初的伊洛瓦伊斯克攻勢雖在戰術上形成對烏軍縱隊的夾擊，卻在外交上引來一月的慕尼黑會談，與會各方把二〇一四年的實際控制線畫成新的接觸線，德巴爾切韋突出部因而被放棄。戰爭自此轉為長期消耗：停火線在二〇一五年至二〇一九年間反覆被突破再修復，二〇一九年的全面停火安排與二〇二〇年的全面換火才換來相對穩定，而最終仍被二〇二二年二月的大規模進攻打破。T-72這一型號的戰時生涯也由此拉長：它是二〇一四年前後頓巴斯戰線上最常見的戰車，兩側都以它為裝甲主力，同一批烏克蘭原產車先是落入分離主義武裝之手，再於往後數年間被烏軍繳獲、修復並重新編成裝甲營，同一型號在這條線上又打了八年。
resultEn: In the event, 2014 settled no victory; it settled a line. The Ukrainian army took up the offensive again after the ceasefire broke down in mid-October: the second battle of Donetsk Airport, launched in the last days of October, ended in heavy losses on the defending side and the Ukrainian withdrawal into the new terminal building; on 26 December Ukrainian troops entered Debaltseve and cut the retreat of two separatist columns, with the Ukrainian side publishing a death toll in the hundreds for the operation. The Ilovaisk offensive of late December and early January achieved an envelopment of Ukrainian columns on the ground, but it brought about the Munich meeting in January, where the participants drew the line of actual control reached in 2014 as the new line of contact, and the Debaltseve salient was thereby given up. From then on the war became a long attritional contest: the ceasefire line was broken and repaired repeatedly between 2015 and 2019, and only the full ceasefire arrangements of 2019 and the comprehensive disengagement of 2020 brought relative stability, which was in the end broken again by the large-scale offensive of February 2022. The wartime career of the T-72 was thereby prolonged: it was the commonest tank on the Donbas front around 2014, the armour of both sides alike, and the same batch of Ukrainian-built vehicles first fell into separatist hands and was later captured, repaired and re-formed into tank companies by Ukraine, so that the type fought on this line for eight more years.
